verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, an MCP server, a sandbox, webhooks, OAuth2 and API versioning, but nothing mentions official client SDKs or language libraries. Raw REST endpoints and an MCP server are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit here. Official SDKs are a fair question for an API-first SaaS platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
